gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Cosmic from the first letter, Galaxy bends its strokes like a paperclip. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi sits below with gaping e shapes and barely rising capitals, so the loud heading gets a quiet, approachable partner.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Wide glass-porthole counters make this body easy to read, with open gaps in c, e, s and a. Noto Sans Rejang gets its best result when you size it up a touch, while Galaxy keeps its ribbon-cut stroke ends up top.

gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Galaxy reads like following a single thread, one line weight winding through its dense, tall lowercase. It makes the loud statement, while Noto Sans Samaritan, a plain sans, offers hefty letters with daylight inside.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-saurashtr: Commanding, Galaxy lays down monoline strokes with lots of space between letters. Noto Sans Saurashtra suits text at a modest size, since its capitals barely stand above their neighbors and its counters stay open to the outside.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC reads quietly, with chalk-like curves that stop short of closing. Galaxy is the one for impact, with no calligraphic shading, while the body font is the one built to carry the words.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Galaxy has zero thick-and-thin contrast, just one unbroken line through tall, dense letters. It earns its keep big and short, and Noto Sans Sharada backs it up with bulky lowercase and open c forms.
